message.content: A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated cell** (often referred to as a *multinucleated giant cell*). In developmental biology, such cells are also described as forming a **syncytium**, which is a single cytoplasmic mass containing multiple nuclei that results from the fusion of several individual cells.
